jobs.title: GTM Product Marketing Manager, Commerce Experiences
jobs.description: <h2><strong>Who we are </strong></h2> <p><strong>About Stripe</strong></p> <p>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. You'll equip customer-facing teams to confidently pitch all our solutions, answer technical questions, and speak to the roadmap. jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Anthropic</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.</p></div><h2 class="heading"><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic's RL Scaling Science team studies how reinforcement learning behaves as we scale it (across model size, compute, and task horizon) and turns that understanding into the training recipes behind our frontier models.
